purpose: Three additional ten-model grids in the approved Animated Fantasy style, featuring new allied units, enemies and environment concepts.

boards.title: D — ROAD ESCORT
boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: new Crownroad animated fantasy game model concept grid.
Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Closely match the approved reference's animated fantasy 3D game style, its moderately exaggerated proportions, expressive faces, sweeping poses, clear sculpted planes, rich color blocks and simple materials. Create an entirely NEW board with the NEW subjects specified below, replacing all original subjects. This is an extension of the same cohesive game asset family.

Layout: one landscape image, exactly TEN equal cells in a clean FIVE-column TWO-row grid. Small header with the specified board title. Small numbered model name with category beneath each model, labels exactly as supplied. Light warm-gray studio background, fine understated dividers, soft contact shadows. Each cell contains exactly one complete model or explicitly described unified unit assembly, not a scenery vignette. Generous padding, no cropped feet, heads, weapons, buildings, mounts or wheels; no crossing dividers. Scale each model independently to fit neatly. Similar three-quarter front camera and lighting for all models; environment models use a compatible raised three-quarter view. Keep all model silhouettes readable.

Approved visual language: polished animated fantasy 3D game models with bold slightly angular shapes, graceful curves and clean simplified sculpting. Adult human proportions around 4.5 to 5 heads tall, larger expressive faces, readable eyebrows and eyes, slightly enlarged hands, boots and class-specific equipment. Dynamic, balanced animation-key poses rather than stiff display poses. Hair is a few sculpted graphic masses; cloth has just a few sweeping folds. Animals and mounted units use coherent stylized animal anatomy. Bone characters have expressive readable skulls and strong gestures. Friendly heroic allies and cartoon menacing enemies; no gore.
Materials: mostly smooth painted color fields, broad soft light/shadow transitions and clean satin metal highlights. A handful of purposeful large seams, buckles, bevels and simplified structural fittings. No photorealism, no realistic cloth weave, no micro scratches, no noisy roughness, no dense rivets, no fine engraving, no deep woodgrain, no chains of tiny accessories, no dense rubble or foliage. Recognizable features matter far more than detail count. Each design has two or three dominant features that read at small game size. Keep clean color separation and restrained magic glows.
Faction colors: Lantern Caravan allies use teal, cream, navy iron, gold/brass and warm brown wood/leather, with a simple lantern emblem when useful. Rotbound Host enemies use burgundy, charcoal iron, pale bone and small green or violet supernatural accents. Environment props belong in the same medieval world, with uncomplicated shape construction.
Lighting: broad warm-neutral studio key, gentle cool fill, soft contact shadows. No outlines, no flat vector art, no pixel art, no plastic toy sheen, no giant chibi heads, no miniature model texture density. Keep the same approachable mature animated-game appearance as the reference. Exactly ten subjects, no background extras, no watermark.

Header text exactly "D — ROAD ESCORT".
Ten NEW subjects in reading order:
01 "SPEARMAN" / "ALLY": adult spear fighter with short brown hair, compact blue-gray helmet, teal tunic over simple light armor, ONE long broad-tipped spear and a small round shield. Clear low forward lunge, spear angled inside the cell. Defining features: spear, round shield, teal tunic.
02 "CROSSBOWMAN" / "ALLY": stocky adult veteran with a large stylized mustache, simple navy shoulder armor and teal scarf, a chunky wood-and-steel crossbow held across his body and one small bolt case. Defining features: crossbow, mustache, wide shoulders.
03 "BATTLE MONK" / "ALLY": athletic bald adult monk with strong kind features, short cream-and-teal robe, broad wrapped forearms, simple belt, glowing amber rune around ONE clenched fist. Strong energetic martial stance. Defining features: bald head, wrapped fists, short robes. No staff or weapon.
04 "WAR HOUND" / "ALLY": one powerful medium-large dog with warm brown fur sculpted into simple masses, alert ears, expressive eyes, a teal cloth harness, a single broad navy armored shoulder plate and one little gold lantern tag. Energetic low forward running pose on four legs, clearly a canine. Defining features: dog silhouette, teal harness, protective shoulder.
05 "GHOUL" / "ENEMY": lean hunched gray-green creature with pointed ears, angular mischievous face and large claw hands, simple burgundy waist wrap. Mid-prowl crouching gesture, no gore or graphic decay. Defining features: long arms, hunched back, claws.
06 "SHIELD WALL" / "ENEMY": one sturdy skeleton infantryman braced behind an oversized rectangular burgundy iron shield, simple blue-gray helmet, one compact spear. Skull and shield read instantly. Defining features: tall rectangular shield, skull, compact spear.
07 "TUNNELER" / "ENEMY": compact burrowing undead goblin-like creature with oversized shovel claws, thick earth-brown shell shoulder armor, pale expressive skull-like face and burgundy scarf. A crouched digging-ready gesture, no surrounding landscape. Defining features: shovel claws, squat body, shell back.
08 "WAYSTATION" / "ENVIRONMENT": one compact timber-and-stone roadside rest house, broad teal roof, a little amber hanging lantern beside a chunky wood door, simple cream wall panels. Defining features: teal roof, doorway, lantern. No people or other buildings.
09 "PALISADE GATE" / "ENVIRONMENT": small complete modular fort gate of a few thick pointed wooden posts and a central heavy timber gate, broad navy iron bands, one teal banner. Defining features: pointed posts, heavy gate, banner.
10 "STONE BRIDGE" / "ENVIRONMENT": isolated short arched stone bridge module with two low chunky parapets, a handful of big light-gray masonry blocks, a little moss on two corners. Complete bridge without a river or scenery. Defining features: single arch, heavy parapets, big blocks.

Ten NEW subjects in reading order:

02 "ALCHEMIST" / "ALLY": expressive adult man with tousled dark hair, teal split-tail coat over cream shirt, leather gloves and boots, one large glowing amber flask raised forward, only TWO broad bottle pouches on the belt. 03 "BERSERKER" / "ALLY": broad muscular adult warrior with a large red beard, teal sash, one navy shoulder plate, thick leather belt, an enormous broad axe. Big lively grounded twist, fully clothed suitable for a cartoon fantasy game. Defining features: red beard, axe, broad body.
04 "BALLISTA CREW" / "ALLY": one compact unified siege unit: a small chunky oak ballista on two thick wheels with ONE adult teal-clad operator standing immediately behind it, hand on its crank. Entire assembled machine and operator fit together in the cell. Defining features: big bow arms, crank, operator. Keep the engineering simple.
05 "SAPPER" / "ENEMY": small darting skeleton saboteur with oversized mischievous skull, burgundy hood and ONE large spherical cartoon bomb clutched against the body, simple belts and foot wraps. 06 "ROT HULK" / "ENEMY": imposing round-bodied gray-green cartoon plague ogre, broad expressive face, burgundy apron, simple iron shoulder plate, one large sickly green belly rune and massive bare forearms. Big ponderous stomping stance. No wounds, exposed organs or gore. Defining features: round belly, apron, green rune.
07 "BONE JUGGERNAUT" / "ENEMY": wide powerful skeleton warrior in a few huge charcoal armor slabs, one large horned bone helmet, burgundy sash and a broad squared stone-and-iron hammer. Heavily braced crouch. Defining features: slab armor, horned helmet, hammer. Not a copy of the previous Grave Brute.
08 "FIELD FORGE" / "ENVIRONMENT": one compact medieval smithing station unified on a small base: chunky stone furnace with an amber opening, big simple anvil directly attached beside it and a short broad chimney, one teal awning strip. Defining features: furnace glow, anvil, chimney. No smith or scattered tools.
09 "SIEGE BARRICADE" / "ENVIRONMENT": one modular barricade of THREE thick angled sharpened oak stakes crossed on one stout timber beam, navy steel brackets, a simple teal pennant. Defining features: diagonal stakes, crossbeam, pennant. No landscape.
10 "SUPPLY CART" / "ENVIRONMENT": one small two-wheeled wooden handcart with two chunky sealed crates, a broad rolled teal blanket and one amber lantern fixed to its front. Defining features: big wheels, crates, teal blanket. No driver, dense cargo or extra props.

02 "BANNER KNIGHT" / "ALLY": confident adult woman with dark sculpted braids, bold blue-gray armor plates, teal cloth, one tall simple teal standard bearing a large gold lantern symbol, sword at belt.
